notes.title: Major update - 0.7.0
notes.content:
Version 0.7.0 is out ! With this update, the [b]co-op mode[/b] is available !

You can now play with one or more Steam friends to Cat Life, following the quest line or exploring the island.

Other minor updates are included, related to the cat mobility.

notes.title: Regular update - 0.6.4
notes.content:
Version 0.6.4 is out, new features and a few corrections for today !
[olist]
[*]Add a select character functionality : when starting a new game, you can now choose a cat model, between 7 cats available.
[*]Add a quick access to unlocked mini-game : when you discover a mini-game and finish it at least one time (with any score), you unlock direct access to it, available in the player menu. With that, you can access to this mini-game from anywhere.
[*]Modify some physics and friction of the cat, smoothing movements and fixing some glitches.
[*]Fixing some building on the terrain, especially in the end game zone.
[*]Fix an issue coming when loading some save game, blocking the loading.
[/olist]

notes.title: Minor update - 0.6.3
notes.content:
Version 0.6.3 is out !

This minor update focuses on some urgent improvements :
[olist]
[*]Add trees in the AI navigation map for path calculation
[*]Fix glitch on climb and unclimb transition
[*]Fix bounce effect when moving on the ground
[*]Fix player jump on slope
[*]Fix problems with water reflection related to occlusion culling
[*]Fix some details on the terrain
[/olist]

notes.title: Minor update - 0.6.2
notes.content:
Version 0.6.2 is out ! It's our first minor update, which focuses on developing the most urgent improvements :
[olist]
[*]Global overhaul of the movement system, with a complete use of physics. Allows, among other things, more realistic movements and the elimination of glitch problems.
[*]Reflection quality settings
[*]Quest display time modified, tutorial quest updated
[*]Healthbar positioning fix
[/olist]
